name: Code de la commande publique — Public Procurement
standard: Code de la commande publique (CCP, Ordonnance 2018-1074)
description: Validates public works contracts against the Code de la commande publique (effective 2019-04-01) and CCAG-Travaux 2021. Runs today: retention within 5 percent (3 percent for an SME working for the State or a large public body), the advance between its minimum (5 percent, 30 percent for an SME working for the State, 10 percent with a large public body) and the usual 30 percent maximum, the CCAG delay penalty of 1/3000 a day capped at 10 percent, price revision weights on contracts longer than three months, and direct payment of subcontractors from EUR 600 including tax. Tender-file checks (publication, thresholds, lots, award criteria, DCE contents) are planned, not built.
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
regulator: Direction des Affaires Juridiques (DAJ), Ministere de l'Economie
superseded_rule_ids_note: ccp.avance_forfaitaire_min_20_pct was dropped: its 20 percent SME minimum is outdated (30 percent with the State since décret 2024-1251) and contracts.public_works_limits checks the advance. ccp.delai_paiement_max_30_days was dropped: the 30, 50 and 60 day public payment terms run as payment clock regimes (fr_ccp_r2192_10, fr_ccp_r2192_11_health, fr_ccp_r2192_11_undertaking).
